List available statistical lint rules

Source: R/lint-rules.R
list_stat_rules.Rd

Returns a tibble summarizing all currently registered statistical lint rules (built-in plus any user-registered custom rules).

Usage

list_stat_rules(category = NULL, severity = NULL)

Arguments

category

Optional character vector to filter rules by category.

severity

Optional character vector to filter rules by severity ("error", "warning", "info").

Value

A tibble::tibble with columns id, severity, category, title, description, and recommendation.

Examples

list_stat_rules()
#> # A tibble: 20 × 6
